NODE_INSTRUCTION_MISSING.description: Node instruction pack not found or could not be loaded
NODE_INSTRUCTION_MISSING.resolution: Ensure node instruction card exists at the expected location
NODE_INSTRUCTION_MISSING.recovery: Load default instruction pack or route to failure handler

NODE_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_MISSING.resolution: Create or locate evidence contract schema
NODE_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_MISSING.recovery: Skip evidence production and route to failure handler

NODE_LOG_CONTRACT_MISSING.resolution: Create or locate log contract schema
NODE_LOG_CONTRACT_MISSING.recovery: Skip log production and route to failure handler

NODE_NEXT_ROUTE_MISSING.resolution: Verify route exists in profile registry
NODE_NEXT_ROUTE_MISSING.recovery: Route to default next-node or fail-closed

NODE_ENTRY_CONDITIONS_FAILED.resolution: Verify prerequisite gate is complete and required artifacts exist
NODE_ENTRY_CONDITIONS_FAILED.recovery: Retry after conditions are met or escalate to human

NODE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.resolution: Provide all required inputs or use defaults
NODE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.recovery: Use defaults or retry with complete inputs

NODE_ACTION_VIOLATION.description: Node attempted action not in allowed_actions list
NODE_ACTION_VIOLATION.resolution: Review node implementation and update allowed_actions

NODE_EVIDENCE_FAILED.recovery: Retry evidence production or emit event only

NODE_LOG_FAILED.recovery: Retry log production or skip if non-critical

NODE_NEXT_RESOLVE_FAILED.resolution: Verify route profile and resolution logic
NODE_NEXT_RESOLVE_FAILED.recovery: Route to failure handler or human escalation

NODE_RETRY_EXCEEDED.resolution: Increase max_attempts or fix root cause
NODE_RETRY_EXCEEDED.recovery: Route to failure handler with full context

NODE_ROLLBACK_FAILED.resolution: Verify rollback prerequisites and action validity
